payload.title: R4: Remove the lesson 6 cliff: lamps before flip, one new control per lesson, Run label consistent (S to M)
payload.description:
Effort: S to M (a 'number only' lens in D5 may need code).

**Problem.** Too many new elements at once.
**Evidence.** The flip lens in lesson 6 shows bands, hex 0x13, 'first box zero', 2^20 to 2^31 and '1049875'; the same lesson adds Back, Reset, 'The desk', 'the end of the list', the log, and renames Run to Step. Drafts 06-08 have no ui block.
**Change.** Order lamps (07) before flip (06); a 'number only' flip lens in the first flip lesson, bands in the 'inside the number' lesson; add a ui block to drafts 06-08 that keeps Run and introduces one control per lesson with one line.
**Acceptance.**
- Given the lamps lesson comes first, when the flip lesson opens, then only the number band shows.
- Given lessons 6-8 drafts, then the button reads Run in all of them.
- Each lesson introduces at most one new control.
- No Show me is needed in the flip lesson in the pilot.
